_status: PROPOSED -- NOT APPLIED. This is a draft result-change notice for Mahmood's decision, prepared 2026-09-22. It is not in docs/result_changes.json and no served page has been edited. Applying it changes a served primary result in the UNFLATTERING direction and therefore needs his countersignature, not a quiet repair.
reason: ENDPOINT TRANSFER on the only pooled row. J-EMPHASIS-HF (PMID 28824029, NCT01115855) reports HR 0.85 (0.53-1.36) for its PRIMARY COMPOSITE -- 'The primary endpoint was a composite of death from cardiovascular causes or hospitalization for HF' -- and that tuple is served as this page's All-cause mortality effect. The same abstract reports mortality separately: 'A total of 17 patients (15.3%) in the eplerenone group and 10 patients (9.1%) in the placebo group died.' Re-binding to the trial's own mortality counts gives RR 1.6847 (95% CI 0.808-3.514) by 17/111 vs 10/110, log-scale SE 0.3725, which the orchestrator recomputed independently of the lane and matched to 4 decimal places. The page's held protocol permits a count-derived RR when no published target-outcome effect is available, so RE-BIND is admissible; WITHDRAW would be correct only under an HR-only contract, and 'no mortality result exists' is NOT supported by the held bytes. The change requires an explicit ACTIVE SCALE change HR -> RR: counts cannot recover a hazard ratio or its time-to-event analysis. Mechanism: found by lane WS's wrong-span sweep (2026-09-22) and confirmed by lane WSX's adversarial re-read (12 of 12 CONFIRMED_CONSUMED; this is the 1 of 12 that is a wrong served NUMBER rather than a wrong label); the row already carried endpoint_binding 'unbound_legacy' and admission verdict MIGRATION_STATE_UNBOUND_LEGACY, so the enforcement gate had already marked it unbound on P8 while it remained pooled under the migration exception.
direction_note: The served value reads as a mortality BENEFIT (0.85). The re-bound value favours placebo (1.685). The error is in the flattering direction; the correction is not.

derivation.formula: RR = (a/n1)/(c/n2); log-scale SE = sqrt(1/a - 1/n1 + 1/c - 1/n2); CI = exp(log RR +/- 1.96 SE)
